response.sql: WITH state_totals AS (SELECT c.State, SUM(i.Total) AS state_total, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId WHERE CAST(i.InvoiceDate AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2010-06-22 00:00:00' AND '2012-06-26 00:00:00' GROUP BY c.State) SELECT SUM(state_total) AS total_invoice_total, AVG(invoice_count) AS avg_invoices_per_state FROM state_totals;

assumptions.assumption: InvoiceDate converts to text in a YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format, so text comparison follows chronological order.
